rules: A check reports pass only when the thing was measured and met its threshold; an absent tool or an unmeasurable value is fail (required tool absent) or unknown, never pass.
skipped means the check was deliberately not run and carries a reason; skipped and unknown never count as pass.
Evidence is redacted: home directory shown as ~, user name and host name replaced wherever they occur in a path, no environment values or credentials.
Doctor shares the 5 s wall-clock budget per run with validate (FR-060): each socket dial, git --version and daemon.json read draws on it.

Local checks read only; they create no file, start no process other than the fixed git --version and, for config.valid, the fixed Git invocations of validate (FR-055), and send no data over the network.

thresholds.confirmation: Owner-confirmed 2026-10-17 (Werner, chat): "Git >= 2.39.5, 2 GiB, 64/256/64 KiB, 5 s, 256 MiB seems to be fine from my side."
thresholds.note: Changing a threshold needs a spec amendment and a test change.

order: DOCKER_HOST (unix:// only; when set it is the only candidate)
socket_candidates.note: Discovery connects to the socket and sends nothing; no Docker API call is made, no runtime is installed or configured. A tcp:// DOCKER_HOST is reported unknown (remote daemon not checked).

checks.unknown: unsupported_platform: platform not in the host-platform matrix; remaining read-only checks still run

checks.pass: a Docker-compatible socket accepts a connection
checks.fail: no candidate socket, or connection refused or denied (remediation links docs/container-runtime.md)

checks.pass: git found and version at least the minimum
checks.fail: git absent, older than the minimum, or (macOS) a shim that would open the Command Line Tools installer, detected without executing it

checks.pass: free bytes on the filesystem of the current directory at least the threshold
free bytes on the container storage filesystem at least the threshold (Linux, /var/lib/docker readable)
checks.unknown: location not discoverable without the runtime API, /var/lib/docker unreadable, or a non-default data root; the measured path or reason is given as evidence. Default data root evidence: DOCKER_HOST unset or unix, and /etc/docker/daemon.json absent or without a data-root key (read with the same bounds as other files); otherwise unknown

checks.pass: workharbor.json in the current directory validates with no error finding (same code as validate)
checks.skipped: no workharbor.json in the current directory (precondition_absent); also not_in_increment until the real validator is wired (T034)
checks.unknown: the remainder of the shared 5 s budget was exhausted (not_measurable)

checks.skipped: not_in_increment: no host credential exists before setup (FR-021)
not_in_increment: no agent service unit before T015
